prompt: WCAG 2.1 relative luminance definition red threshold corrected value
answer: The corrected WCAG 2.1 red threshold is **0.04045**, replacing **0.03928**. The change was recorded in the WCAG 2.1 errata on **February 22, 2022**. It has no practical effect on calculations using 8-bit color values.
